description:
Two years of digital simulations and road testing with Team Biesse–Carrera–Premac professionals aren’t something you see. They’re something you feel. You’ll feel it under the pedals through fast corners and on long straights where others lose ground. We redesigned every millimetre of the frame with one obsession: eliminating aerodynamic drag without adding a single gram. The result? A pure racing machine weighing just 850 g in size M. Zero Compromises. Pure Aerodynamic Efficiency.

Colour isn’t decoration. It’s identity. For Erakle Pro, we’ve turned light into matter, dressing 850 grams of engineering obsession in four distinctive finishes: Inferno, Prisma, Asfalto and Eclipse. From holographic graphics to the exposed carbon weave, every finish is designed to work with the wind and celebrate performance. Here, aesthetics are the natural consequence of speed.

If our curated combinations aren’t enough, start with a blank canvas. From colour selection to finishes (matte, gloss or mixed), right down to the finest graphic details, we’ll create a Carrera that’s uniquely yours.

Built from aerospace-grade graphite fibre and precision vacuum moulding free from structural imperfections, Erakle Pro minimises turbulence, eliminates every unnecessary milligram and transforms every watt of power into pure acceleration.

Full-carbon construction, available in multiple configurations to fine-tune your riding position. Seamlessly integrated with the frame, it eliminates airflow disruptions at the front of the bike.

The dropped seatstay design lowers the bike’s centre of gravity and improves cornering responsiveness without compromising comfort. The curved seat tube absorbs road vibrations while ensuring highly efficient power transfer.

The rear wheel is tightly integrated into the seat tube to minimise turbulence generated by its rotation.

Compatible with tyres up to 34 mm, allowing you to tackle any road surface without compromising the frame’s aerodynamic performance.

The bottom bracket shell features an asymmetric design to maximise torsional stiffness on the drivetrain side.

From XS to XL, the Erakle Pro monocoque frame is engineered to deliver the same balance of aerodynamics and power transfer for every rider. If you already know your bike fit measurements, use the Stack and Reach values to identify your ideal frame size.
